name: Template: Project Delivery
description: Track cross-functional projects from planning through retrospective. Each swimlane is a project; each card is a deliverable or milestone.

swimlanes.name: Mobile App Relaunch
swimlanes.notes: Full redesign + new feature set. Q2 launch target. Sponsor: VP Product.

swimlanes.name: Data Platform Migration
swimlanes.notes: Migrate from Redshift to Snowflake. 3 TB data. Zero-downtime required.

swimlanes.name: Security Compliance Audit
swimlanes.notes: SOC 2 Type II audit. Auditor engaged. Evidence collection deadline: end of Q2.

swimlanes.name: Customer Portal v2
swimlanes.notes: Self-service portal for invoices, usage, support. Design approved, dev in progress.

swimlanes.name: GDPR Deletion Pipeline
swimlanes.notes: Automate right-to-erasure requests. Legal deadline: 90 days from receipt.
